name: 00 Repo Audit & Setup
description: Stabilize the repo, exports, security hygiene, lint baseline, dependency posture, and CI prerequisites.

name: 01 MVP Foundation
description: Verify auth, Supabase schema, data isolation, environment setup, and foundational route behavior.

name: 02 Core Product Flow
description: Harden upload, extraction, anomaly, draft, export, delete, and billing flows for MVP usage.

name: 03 Production Readiness
description: Add operational, privacy, security, observability, deployment, and regression coverage.

name: 04 Launch Candidate
description: Complete final responsive, accessibility, deployment, monitoring, and beta acceptance checks.

name: 05 Later Enhancements
description: Hold non-MVP support/admin and scale enhancements until the core product is production-safe.
